# Parts

Every part a scene can use, as the pictorial sheet draws it. A part names its `kind` from this list; its `behaviour` decides what it does (see [the scene format](../scene-format.md)). The drawing moves with the simulation: what moves is in the last column.

## Sources

| | kind | usual role | draws |
| - | - | - | - |
| <img src="symbols/kind-sun.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `sun` | source | the sun; rays turn with output |
| <img src="symbols/kind-wind.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `wind` | source | wind streams; flow with output |
| <img src="symbols/kind-pv.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `pv` | converter | a solar panel; cells colour with output |
| <img src="symbols/kind-gaswell.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `gaswell` | source | a gas wellhead |
| <img src="symbols/kind-core.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `core` | source | a reactor core; rods glow with output |
| <img src="symbols/kind-grid.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `grid` | storage | a pylon standing for the public grid |
| <img src="symbols/kind-rain.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `rain` | source | a cloud; rain falls with output |
| <img src="symbols/kind-air.svg" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | `air` | source | outside air; a breeze with output |
